tools.name: size_me
tools.description: Recommends a size in one shirt for this man, from the shirts he already owns that fit. Returns the size, why (in terms of his own shirts), how it will fit, and a confidence. The size already accounts for his shirts, the fabric (including dryer shrinkage) and the cut.

tools.name: what_to_buy
tools.description: Builds his FitCard from the shirts he owns and returns the shirts that will fit him, each in the right size, with a buy link. Also returns a link to his full card on fitcard.ai. Each size already accounts for his shirts and the fabric; a "snugger" or "roomier" note describes how that size fits.

tools.name: shirt_measurements
tools.description: The real garment measurements of a shirt (chest all the way around and length, in inches) in each size, from the brand's own chart or other checked sources. Not a body-size chart.
